company.name: Aztec
company.shortDescription: Aztec develops an ethereum trading protocol that enables private transactions across the public blockchain.
company.description: Aztec develops an ethereum trading protocol that enables private transactions across the public blockchain. Its renowned research team is the force behind PLONK, the lightning-fast standard in zero-knowledge technologies. The team has brought multiple R&D breakthroughs to Layer 2 on Ethereum and has deep experience in deploying complex cryptosystems to Web3.

productsAndServices.description: A privacy-preserving Ethereum Layer 2 for deploying smart contracts with configurable private and public data, identity, and computation.
productsAndServices.name: Aztec Network

productsAndServices.description: An open-source, Rust-like programming language for writing zero-knowledge programs and privacy-preserving smart contracts without requiring specialized cryptography expertise.
productsAndServices.name: Noir

productsAndServices.description: A software stack for building, testing, deploying, and interacting with privacy-preserving smart contracts on Aztec, including contract frameworks, local execution, SDKs, and testing tools.
productsAndServices.name: Aztec Developer Platform

productsAndServices.description: A zero-knowledge proving system optimized for generating private transaction proofs in browsers and on resource-constrained devices such as smartphones.
productsAndServices.name: Aztec Client-Side Proving System (CHONK)
